entries.reason: The maintainer's own documents: the ownership model and the binding contract. They are not rewritten by contributors.
The rules, their test fixtures and this list have to spell out the words and shapes they forbid.
The source inventory records the exact historical file path; renaming that path in the inventory would misidentify the input.
These dated records preserve literal evidence filenames, even though the evidence was not committed; rewriting a basename would falsify its provenance.
